notes.title: Updated Lake Ridden to 1.7.1852
notes.content:
[h1]Lake Ridden 1.7.1852[/h1]
Lake Ridden has been updated with a new Unity3d-engine version and a bunch of fixes and tweaks to improve the gameplay experience.

[list]
[*] - Updated Unity3d engine version to fix some issues from later windows updates
[*] - Revamped the mouse looking to make it more responsive
[*] - Removed head bobbing and increased FOV to reduce motion sickness
[*] - Performance improvements in most scenes
[*] - Added new option Options/Graphics/Resolution down-scaling if you have issues with low fps
[*] - Visual improves in certain areas
[*] - Changed anti-aliasing to temporal AA for
[*] - Small bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Lake Ridden Patch #5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/4b23f9928cc223dde83d3d653b410d7b8cc39aca.jpg[/img]

Hi all! This version is focused on major performance improvements and for some of you who have reported issues with saves. We also added a few fixes noted during our recent showing at EGX.

Lake Ridden Change log 1.5
[list]
 [*] Improved save disk handling
 [*] Improved performance, especially when moving around in the game
 [*] Small game play improvements
[/list]

If you experience bugs in the game, drop us an email to support@midnighthub.com and we'll do our best to help you out!

Cheers,
The Lake Ridden Team

notes.title: The Controller Patch (#4)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/eac518c37a1b43a3d0a7ac2f23d6a7d48c1bbb3e.jpg[/img]

Hi all! We finally have controller support ready for the game. We have also seen that some people are having issues with performance and we hope this version will help with that. Please let us know if it doesn't and we'll see how we can help.

Lake Ridden Changelog 1.4
[list]
 [*] Controller support (Xbox- and PS4-controllers verified working)
 [*] Big improvement on performance in low and medium graphics presets for nights (could result in 20 fps higher on some devices)
 [*] Improved fog visibility around the village
 [*] Minor text tweaks
[/list]

If you experience bugs in the game, drop us an email to support@midnighthub.com and we'll do our best to help you out!

Cheers,
The Lake Ridden Team

notes.title: Lake Ridden Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/ac9fe5d5ea4f5cdafeda62ce144f79e1f8f536fb.jpg[/img]

Hi all, and thanks for your awesome feedback! We are working on controllers and Patch 3 has partial support. Full support should be added in the next few weeks.

Lake Ridden Changelog 1.3
[list]
 [*] Added a map of the village area
 [*] Increased contrast on some screens, especially at night
 [*] Improved performance when moving between zones in the game
 [*] Improved performance in the garden
 [*] Improved saving/loading for Island puzzles
 [*] Improved performance and reliability of saves
 [*] Added new frame smoothing for mouse input
 [*] The camera would turn wildly during scene loads
 [*] The game no longer runs in the background
 [*] Changing resolution in the game would be unreliable on some PCs
 [*] Minor tweaks to hints and objectives
 [*] Lots of additional minor fixes
[/list]

If you experience bugs in the game make sure to drop us an email to support@midnighthub.com and we'll do our best to help you out!

Cheers,
The Lake Ridden Team

notes.title: Lake Ridden Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/cecaa4a31e8a063d1740ae8e0669c4290c806eec.jpg[/img]

Hello all, thanks so much for playing Lake Ridden and letting us know your feedback! Our team of 2 coders and 2 artists are working around the clock to improve the game for you <3 Thanks for your patience!

Lake Ridden Changelog 1.2
[list]
[*]A lot of performance improvements, especially in the beginning
[*]Start game screen was missing an inventory button hint
[*]Lights would pop in and out in certain places around the game
[*]The player could get stuck in drawers 
[*] Minor texture tweaks
[/list]

Fixes that are potential spoilers:
[spoiler]
* Ingredients could be added to a finished brew
* The laundry box could disappear under certain conditions
* The projector and its sound should now turn off when leaving it
* The spring was invisible before the player could get it
[/spoiler]

If you experience bugs in the game make sure to drop us an email to support@midnighthub.com and we'll do our best to help you out!

Cheers,
The Lake Ridden Team

notes.title: Lake Ridden Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/81fe43dbecab30a55be4ceadc7a29ef83ddf8b82.jpg[/img]
Hi all, thank you so much for playing Lake Ridden <3 Releasing our first game as a studio together has been such an amazing (and very stressful) experience. 

We're reading every single comment and all the feedback we can find, so keep it comin'! Here's our first patch to improve Lake Ridden:

Lake Ridden Changelog 1.1
[list]
 [*]A player could previously fall through the ground when clicking continue
 [*]The player should no longer be stuck in the basement
 [*]V-sync should now be properly set on startup
 [*]Changed some texts to make it easier to find places
 [*]Fixed outer bounds were a player could move outside of the world
 [*]It is now easier to rebind shift and ctrl for other functions
 [*]Gate rotation puzzles now work better with low-resolution textures
 [*]Keyholes added to doors that were missing them
[/list]
Next up we'll continue fixing bugs. In parallel to this, we'll hopefully start working on the Mac port and the controller support as soon as possible. Thanks for your patience! 

If you enjoyed the game please consider leaving a review since every review means the world to a small indie studio like us!

Cheers,
The Lake Ridden Team

notes.title: Lake Ridden Gameplay and Releasedate Trailer Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30576652/8543cd3a3f252ca11f5705024c6bb343867a799f.jpg[/img]

Hi all! Lake Ridden will be available on May the 10th! It's hard to believe something we've worked on for the past 2,5 years will soon be live for you to play and enjoy! We really hope you appreciate the brand new trailer we made to celebrate this! 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/256715222/movie480.webm?t=1524731233]Lake Ridden trailer on Steam[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RvUGYnKDB2o

Lake Ridden has a playtime of roughly 6h – 9h, and it will be sold for 19,99€/19,99$/14,99£. At release, our game will run on PC only, but we’ll do our very best to make sure it also runs on Mac and support controllers as soon as possible after release! If you’re as excited as we are, make sure to tell your friends about Lake Ridden and help us spread the word.

If you’re press and looking to cover Lake Ridden, drop us an email to: press@midnighthub.com. Keymailer link for streamers [url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/48039] HERE [/url]

Cheers,
- The Lake Ridden Team
